rules: clip audio muted; A1 dialogue (EN), A2 SFX, no BGM; KO subtitles

clips.action: smoke drifts left while ash rises to the right against the wind.
the crows turn their heads south all at once.
beneath the frozen lake a vast shape moves under the ice.
the cracked bronze bell trembles faintly, ash falling from its lip.
ash settles on the small medical knife; a faint ember glint on the blade.

Extreme close-up of a crow's black eye in razor focus, the burning village reflected small and curved in its glossy iris; feathers dusted with ash. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

Overhead top view insert: hundreds of refugee footprints pressed into grey ash on a dirt road, all leading out of frame; a small carved wooden toy horse half-buried in the ash. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

Extreme close-up of a woman's ash-dusted knuckles pulling a strip of undyed linen bandage taut; fibers and ash flakes in razor focus, everything else melting into bokeh. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.
refugees stream out of frame; Elara works on the wounded without looking up.
Elara presses a bandage, never looking up.
Elara's jaw tightens, eyes hard, ash drifting past her face.
Elara gently holds the girl's shoulders and asks her something quietly. Elara speaks softly with natural lip movement (dialogue will be dubbed later).
Elara's trembling hand slowly closes into a fist to hide the shaking.
Elara and the girl stay small and still as the refugee line recedes into haze.

Extreme close-up macro of frayed linen bandage fibers just cut, loose threads catching a faint ember-amber glint; shallow focus. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

the worn engraving catches an ember-amber glint.

Low-angle insert of a scorched bronze winged-firebird relief on a stone altar, wax drips frozen down its wings, shallow depth of field, candle glow on bronze. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

grey light shafts shift; the wounded soldier stirs on the pew as Elara enters.
the soldier's eyes open and stare up at the knife at his throat.
the girl in the doorway asks a question, backlit. Child speaks softly with natural lip movement (dialogue will be dubbed later).
Elara answers quietly, half her face in shadow. Elara speaks softly with natural lip movement (dialogue will be dubbed later).

Extreme close-up of a young woman's dark-brown iris, a candle flame reflected and trembling in it, the pupil widening; fine freckles at the edge of frame. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

the rope sways against the grey sky.
a mother's hand reaches through the crowd.
small worn shoes stand still among moving feet.

Low-angle extreme close-up of an iron-shod warhorse hoof striking ash-covered stone, a burst of grey ash exploding upward, frozen motion, shallow focus. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

Dutch-angle insert of a midnight-blue war banner with a silver wolf in an iron chain collar snapping in the wind, ash streaming past, background soldiers out of focus. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

armored figures fill the doorway in hard backlight, ash swirling.
Elara holds the knife steady, shielding the girl.
a sword tip lowers into frame toward the floor.
Elara speaks firmly to Riven, not lowering her knife. Elara speaks softly with natural lip movement (dialogue will be dubbed later).
a gauntleted hand checks the neat stitches on the wound.
Torval grips his sword hilt and speaks one word to his commander. Torval speaks softly with natural lip movement (dialogue will be dubbed later).
Riven stays silent, his eyes lowering to her hands.
Elara's fist tightens around the wolf-emblem scrap.

Extreme close-up of a leather-gauntleted thumb pushing a plain steel sword one inch back into its scabbard, metal edge catching cold side light, shallow focus. Subtle living motion only (drifting ash, flicker, fibers moving); a quiet bridge insert between scenes.

ash rises upward through the broken roof into the sky.

distant bells swing by themselves.
a single glowing ember feather drifts down into the chapel.
the ember lands on the palm and glows without burning.
amber light rises on Riven's face; his sword slowly lowers.

the hooded figure stands motionless above the smoking chapel.
lips in the shadow of the hood speak one line. Observer speaks softly with natural lip movement (dialogue will be dubbed later).

dialogue.speaker: ELDER
dialogue.en: Elara, come on. They'll be back.

dialogue.speaker: ELARA
dialogue.en: Go on ahead. Someone over there is still breathing.
dialogue.ko: 먼저 가세요. 저기 아직 숨 쉬는 사람 있어요.

dialogue.speaker: ELDER
dialogue.en: Save the enemy, and you become the enemy. Just like your mother.
dialogue.ko: 적을 살리면 너도 적이 되는 거다. 네 어미처럼.

dialogue.speaker: ELARA
dialogue.en: Then stay with me until you do.
dialogue.ko: 그럼 생각날 때까지 내 옆에 있어.

dialogue.speaker: CHILD
dialogue.en: Why are you saving him? His people burned our home...
dialogue.ko: 왜 저 사람을 살려요? 저 사람들이 우리 집을…

dialogue.speaker: ELARA
dialogue.en: He's your soldier. If you want him, press on the wound first.

dialogue.speaker: ELARA
dialogue.en: See any other healer around here?
dialogue.ko: 여기 의사가 나 말고 또 보여?
